assessments.reasoning: In Section 1 Question 4, relationships are captured exclusively relative to the head of the household (e.g. Jefe, Cónyuge, Hijo/a, Yerno/nuera, Nieto/a, Padres/suegros, Otros parientes, Empleado doméstico, Otros no parientes). No member-to-member matrix or pointer variables (such as mother, father, or partner ID) are collected, so member_to_member_relationships is false. However, extended ties beyond spouse and parent-child can be identified relative to the head (such as grandchild, parent-in-law, son/daughter-in-law, other parientes, and non-kin), so extended_ties is true. The criterion for defining and separating a household is explicitly stated in Section 1 ('persons who usually eat and sleep in this household'), so multiple_household_criteria is true. Sub-units (such as family nuclei or secondary families) cannot be identified because no pointer variables or sub-unit codes exist, making sub_units false. Finally, while Section 2 Question 29a option 1 and Section 3 Question 77 capture general care responsibilities and care bonus receipt, the survey does not record who specifically provides care to whom inside or across households, so caregiving_relationships is false.
